headline: LeviLauncher Modder v1.6.1-modder.6
summary: The CurseForge content screen gets a compact landscape layout and a full gallery viewer: swipe or tap the arrows to browse screenshots at full size, with a thumbnail strip, page counter and animated GIFs. YouTube trailers from the project description play in the viewer too.

items.text: CurseForge content details now use a compact two-pane landscape layout, with the screenshot grid spanning 3-6 columns by width.
The gallery viewer adds swipe and arrow navigation, a page counter, image titles, a thumbnail strip and a close button.
Viewer images render at full size without cropping, and animated GIF screenshots keep playing page by page.
YouTube videos embedded in the project description can be played right inside the gallery viewer.
Holding the Website button on a content page copies its CurseForge link to the clipboard.
